Starting from FastGPT v4.8.16, commercial edition users can import from Yuque file libraries by configuring a Yuque token and uid. This feature is currently in beta — some interactions may still need refinement.

## 1. Get the Yuque Token and UID

Go to the Yuque homepage > click your avatar > Settings to find the relevant parameters.

![Open Yuque account settings](/imgs/image-36.png)

**Personal Edition**:

1. In Settings, open **Token** under **Developer**, then create a new token.
2. Enter a purpose for the token and select **Read your knowledge bases** and **Read your documents**. Confirm creation and copy the token.
3. For the UID, use the account identifier shown below your display name and avatar in Settings.

| Get Token                       | Add Permissions                 | Get User ID                     |
| ------------------------------- | ------------------------------- | ------------------------------- |
| ![Yuque token management](/imgs/image-33.png) | ![Create a token with read permissions](/imgs/image-34.png) | ![Yuque account UID in Settings](/imgs/image-35.png) |

**Enterprise Edition**:

Open **Team Management → Developer → Token** to manage tokens. Token availability depends on your Yuque plan. For the team UID, open the team homepage and copy the first path segment after the domain: in `https://tenant.yuque.com/<team-id>`, use `<team-id>`.

| Get Token                        | Get User ID                      |
| -------------------------------- | -------------------------------- |
| ![Enterprise token management](/imgs/image-109.png) | ![Team UID in the Yuque homepage URL](/imgs/image-108.png) |

## 2. Create the Dataset

Using the token and uid from the previous step, create a Dataset. Select the Yuque file library type, fill in the parameters, and click Create.

![Select the Yuque Dataset type](/imgs/image-37.png)

![Yuque Dataset connection settings](/imgs/image-31.png)

## 3. Import Documents

After creating the Dataset, click `Add File` to import from your Yuque document library and follow the on-screen guidance.

The Yuque Dataset supports scheduled sync — it scans once daily at varying times. If documents have been updated, they will be synced automatically. You can also trigger a manual sync.

![Select Yuque documents to import](/imgs/image-38.png)
